messages.content: Solve the mathematics question using the provided image. Give a clear final answer at the end. For a multiple-choice question, include the option letter in your final answer.

content.text: Eight identical track pieces form the circle shown on the left. A second track begins with the 2 pieces shown on the right and is to be completed as a closed track using the smallest possible number of these pieces. How many pieces will the second track use in total?
